global_run_protocol.isolation: Use synthetic accounts, vessels and commercial particulars. Do not mutate real customer conversations or memory.
global_run_protocol.model_matrix: Run the development set and later frozen holdout against each of the two public model choices, recording actual UI labels and execution identities. Scenarios explicitly involving a model switch require both switch orders. Do not silently pool model-specific outcomes.
global_run_protocol.message_boundary: Only steps with kind=user_message are sent as user chat messages. UI actions and controlled environment actions are performed and logged separately.
global_run_protocol.adaptive_turns: Deliver later user turns in sequence. Do not add facts, hints, tool instructions or target answers. If a candidate asks for an additional genuinely required field, freeze that field from the independent operational/source fixture before completing the case. Score needless questions as over-clarification.
global_run_protocol.oracles: Resolve authoritative-source references independently before candidate output is inspected. Freeze source snapshots and derived amounts. If unresolved, mark monetary correctness UNRESOLVED_ORACLE; do not turn missing truth into a pass.

scoring.execution: Did the requested action/run complete at the relevant boundary? Transport success, UI feedback, durable state and provider completion are separate evidence.
scoring.task_completion: Did the user get the requested answer or state change? A safe clarification may be correct for an incomplete turn while the full task remains incomplete.
scoring.truth: Check every requested line item, units, arithmetic, time basis, applicability, citation and effective date against the independent oracle; no single plausible total is sufficient.
scoring.clarification: A necessary question is successful clarification, not completed estimation. A request containing complete supplied-rate inputs should be calculated; source uncertainty is not an excuse to refuse that arithmetic.
scoring.aggregation: Report counts and denominators by task type, catalog entry, model and evidence boundary. Never merge unresolved or unexercised cases into passes.

global_run_protocol.runtime_faults: Fault-injection scenarios require isolated fixtures and authorization. Do not infer real-provider reliability from mocks. Do not incur paid inference during authoring.
global_run_protocol.cancellation: Freeze an operationally justified observation window before execution. If the response finishes before Stop/delete, cancellation is NOT_EXERCISED. UI cancellation does not alone prove external provider work or billing stopped.
global_run_protocol.seal: Only development.json may be shared with implementers before candidate freeze. Holdout is a workflow seal backed by a SHA-256 content hash, not a cryptographic access-control system. Open only after candidate revision, prompts, configuration, provider settings and development-run results are frozen. If revealed early, retire affected holdout cases.
global_run_protocol.coverage_limit: This is an initial finite workflow pack. A later complete charge/rule/exception inventory may add source and reference obligations. This pack cannot establish universal tariff correctness, exhaustive coverage, successful live vessel-provider lookup, or production readiness.
